messages:
Erin: Pegasus Labs NDA countersigned. Need to lock EAP bench checklist + shipping ETA.
Pegasus-poc: Shipping 4 dev boards next Tue. We'll upload driver image `pegasus-rt-2026.img` and a reference container to portal. Will DM vault token.
Pablo: Partner requests focus on int8 throughput and cold-start latency for chat. Also wants power measurements.
Jen: Bench plan: latency sweep (seq 32/128/512), throughput steady-state, int8 accuracy check. Use `benchkit`. Add flags `--strip-firmware --anonymize`.
Ops-Ray: Need exact run cmds and image SHA to bake into infra job and request egress.
Pablo: Example commands:
```
benchkit run --model rwd-chat-7b --mode latency --seq 128 --batch 4 --out s3://bench/pegasus/1887654321/latency
benchkit run --model rwd-chat-7b --mode throughput --seq 1024 --batch 32 --out s3://bench/pegasus/1887654321/throughput
benchkit run --model rwd-chat-7b --mode quant --quant int8 --out s3://bench/pegasus/1887654321/quant
```
Legal-bot: NDA note: forbid microcode dumps and raw JTAG traces in uploads. Partner copy must be scrubbed.
Bench-bot: Latency pass queued on infra-gpu-21. Est ~2h. Artifacts -> s3://bench/pegasus/1887654321/meta.json when done.
Bench-bot: Latency pass complete: seq32 p50=3.0ms p99=10.5ms; seq512 p50=12.0ms p99=46.8ms. Throughput queued. Full artifacts will be scrubbed per NDA before partner share.
Erin: Action items: (1) Pegasus upload driver/container (pegasus-poc), (2) Ops bake golden image + egress (ops-ray), (3) Run throughput + quant and produce internal + scrubbed partner reports (pablo/jen), (4) Legal review partner copy. Quick sync Thu 11am PT to review.
Jen: I'll stash raw CSVs and run scrub pipeline before upload.
Pegasus-poc: Noted. We'll provide power helper script and smoke test.
Erin: Thanks team. Drop blockers here. :rocket:
